# sharpens

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sharpens`](gmeow-sharpens.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sharpens>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)

S1 sharpens S2: every precisification S1 admits is also admitted by S2, so S1 is the more specific frame (the standpoint ⊆ / refinement relation of [`Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) Logic; CKR's coverage relation). Transitive. Every standpoint sharpens [`gmeow:universalStandpoint`](../individuals/gmeow-universalStandpoint.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) -> [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md)
